Retrieval: Full WebFetch, 18 Jul 2026. Publication 3 Jul 2026. Fieldwork 25–30 June 2026, sample 1,045 UK adults 18+.

Voting intention: Reform UK 26%, Labour 24%, Conservatives 18%, Green 13%, Lib Dem 11%.

Preferred Prime Minister: Andy Burnham 30%, Nigel Farage 16%, Kemi Badenoch 13%.

Quote (Keiran Pedley, Director of Politics, Ipsos): "Labour will be more optimistic about the future than they were a month ago. However, the jury is out with the public on whether Burnham himself is ready to be Prime Minister."
